heroSummary: SJUSD's two-hour early releases are grade-specific: elementary windows fall in October and March, while secondary windows close each semester. Graduation ceremonies begin May 24 before all schools release early on May 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When does San José Unified start and end school in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: San José Unified students start school on Thursday, August 5, 2027. The last day is Friday, May 26, 2028, and the published student calendar identifies it as an early-release day for all schools. Families should confirm the final-day dismissal time with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San José Unified Spring Recess in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs from Monday, April 3 through Friday, April 7, 2028. Students return on Monday, April 10. Families should still check school communications for campus-specific activities or schedule changes around the recess.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27?
content: School starts one day earlier, on August 5; the 2026–27 school year began August 6.
The last day is one calendar day earlier, moving from May 27 to May 26.
Fall Recess runs September 27–October 1 instead of September 28–October 2, while Spring Recess runs April 3–7 instead of April 5–9.

groups.label: Early-release dates vary by school level
items: SJUSD lists separate shortened-day periods for elementary schools, secondary schools, and all schools.

groups.label: May 26 is both the last day and an early-release day
items: All schools are scheduled to dismiss two hours early on Friday, May 26.

groups.label: Graduation and secondary early-release dates overlap in the final week
items: High school graduation ceremonies run May 24–25, while the secondary early-release window runs May 23–25.
